summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing for Abdullah Obaidi law office bilingual portal. Backend: 21/21 pytest tests pass across public/lawyer-auth/clients/cases/invoices/documents/messages/notifications/appointments/client-portal (cookie session). Frontend: landing page, lang toggle (RTL/LTR), lawyer login, dashboard nav, stat cards, clients CRUD, cases CRUD, invoices CRUD, notifications, messages, logout all verified. Client portal verified via mongo-seeded session cookie: overview, messages send, appointment book, cases/documents/invoices/notifications tabs all render.

issues: Benign 'ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications' from Radix UI Dialog gets shown as an uncaught runtime error by the CRA/webpack dev overlay, which covers the screen and can block interactions. This is dev-only cosmetic; consider adding a small window.addEventListener('error', ...) handler to suppress this specific message so the dev overlay doesn't fire, or ensure Radix versions handling. Does not affect production build.

Console warns 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' — add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby={undefined} explicit) to all DialogContents (client-dialog, case-dialog, case-view-dialog, doc-dialog, invoice-dialog, notif-dialog, c-appt dialog) for accessibility.

action_items: Suppress dev-only 'ResizeObserver loop' warning so the CRA error overlay doesn't cover the UI (window addEventListener('error') filter, or upgrade Radix).
Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to all Radix DialogContent components to remove a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 813 lines — consider splitting routers by domain (auth/clients/cases/invoices/documents/messages/appointments/client-portal) for maintainability.

download_document uses inner try/except HTTPException to convert 401 from get_client_user — currently loses 403 (forbidden) semantics; the returned status is always 401 when client auth fails, and 403 when authenticated-but-not-owner is only reached if get_client_user succeeded (OK). Consider clearer flow.
Client cookie is set with samesite='none' & secure=True — fine for cross-site, but Emergent auth flow relies on the Google session_token being stored as-is; verify domain scope for production.
seed_lawyer stores password_hash from env at first run; if LAWYER_DEFAULT_PASSWORD changes later, it is NOT re-hashed (idempotent-safe but confusing) — document this behavior.
No pagination on list endpoints (.to_list(1000/2000)) — acceptable for MVP but should paginate later.
get_client_user error message is Arabic-only (403). For English UI, consider returning a structured code.

Only remaining known issue is the CRA dev overlay catching Radix ResizeObserver warnings, which does not reflect a real production bug. Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py can be reused as regression suite.
